description: Chart. Render a Chart.js image via GET. Pass the full chart object as URL-encoded JSON in query. Prefer format png for ChatGPT. POST sends the same object as a JSON body, not query. Credit cost: 5 credits per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: Full chart config as URL-encoded JSON. Pass ?version= or ?v= separately to pin the chart version.

share.description: If true, persist the result and return share URLs instead of an image. Leave false to get the image.

version.description: Chart.js version to use. Alias: ?v=. Only v4.x is supported. Defaults to the installed version (4.5.1). Example: "4", "4.5", "4.5.1". The installed version is always returned in the X-ChartJS-Version response header. Default: "4.5.1".
